svg.title: dsh-marker
svg.desc: Visual browser annotations as first-class context for DeepSeek Harness: a marked element and its comment in the browser become a mention chip, a cropped screenshot and a DOM anchor in the running DSH session.
svg.text: Point at text, an element, or a region — cropped screenshots,
DOM selectors, and intent land directly in your DSH session.
